name: All Research Areas
description:
My Research Interests
I am currently working in wireless sensing and localization domain. I also have expertise in building systems for air quality monitoring. You can filter by each research area to know more about my contribution in each, along with the relevant papers.

name: Wireless Sensing
description: I am involved in developing systems for orchestrating wireless infrastructure for sensing and communication purposes. My research involves using visual priors to maintain digital twins and use them to take informed decisions, making proactive and dynamic infrastructures possible.

name: Air Quality Monitoring
description: During my M.Tech., I worked in building systems for air quality monitoring. I have developed methods for automated sensor drift detection, sensor validation, and automated mitigation suggestions.
